description: Segments cyclables 2021 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Maremne adour Côte-Sud. CCMACS cycling segments. Coverage: Communauté de communes Maremne adour Côte-Sud. The portal shows the English title as "2021 cycling segments" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de communes Maremne adour Côte-Sud. Its keywords include ccmacs, itineraire, donnees-ouvertes-1, velo, reseaux, ccmacs-donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 4 download or service links in OGC:WMS, SHAPEFILE, OGC:WFS, HYPERLINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
